```{bash}

aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket vr-sling --prefix "Southeast+Regional+Fellows+Course/"

```

```{bash}

aws s3 ls s3://vr-sling/ --recursive

```

```{bash}

aws s3api list-objects-v2 \
  --bucket vr-sling \
  --prefix "Southeast Regional Fellows Course/"

```
```{bash}

aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket vr-sling --delimiter "/" | grep Prefix

```
